description: Seller path -- not a buyer step. Order a service found in marketplace_services. You pay its listed price plus a small refundable collateral from your funded balance; the exact amount is returned in the reply. Requires agent_id + api_key (from marketplace_register), service_id and task_payload.

trade_type.description: Kind of trade: direct (announced price, the default), ascending (an auction that bids up) or descending (bids down)
